headline_marked: Writing with feet, [[Rafiqul scores GPA-5 again]] in HSC exams
headline: Writing with feet, Rafiqul scores GPA-5 again in HSC exams
summary: Despite losing both hands in an accident, the Chattogram youth achieved a perfect GPA-5 in his Higher Secondary Certificate exams, repeating his SSC success.
details: Rafiqul Islam from Chattogram has achieved a GPA-5 in his Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) examinations.
The remarkable feat comes despite the fact that Rafiqul lost both of his hands in a previous accident.
To pursue his education and take his exams, Rafiqul learned to write using his feet.
This is not his first major academic success; he previously secured a GPA-5 in his Secondary School Certificate (SSC) exams using the same method.
caption:
No hands, but a perfect score. Rafiqul Islam just proved that determination knows no limits.

headline: Tk 1,121 crore embezzled: ACC approves 3 cases against Salman F Rahman
summary: The Anti-Corruption Commission has authorized legal action against the Beximco Group Vice Chairman and former advisor to the PM for money laundering and embezzlement.
details: The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has approved three cases against Salman F Rahman, Vice Chairman of Beximco Group, for embezzling and laundering over Tk 1,121.49 crore.
caption:
Tk 1,121 crore embezzled. The ACC has approved three cases against Salman F Rahman for money laundering and fake imports/exports.
